title: Frequency Table → SD
summary: SD-mode loop: enter (value, frequency) pairs, then S-VAR. 85 bytes.

body.text: dse.best lists a frequency-entry helper because MODE 4 plus ; is easy to mistype under exam pressure. Create the slot in SD. The program turns FreqOn, clears old STAT data, then loops ? → X, ? → Y, X ; Y DT. AC when the table is finished, then SHIFT 2 (S-VAR) for x̄, σx, sx. Variance is σx² (population) or sx² (sample).

body.label: Memory / run mode
body.text: 85 bytes of the shared 680-byte pool. Create the slot in SD, FreqOn. Type ? → : ◢ Goto Lbl If Then from SHIFT 3 (P-CMD).
Question: Use this program to solve the case: 75 once, 80 twice, 85 four times.
Given: Same table as the SD page on this site.

items: MODE → 6 → 2 → slot (program was created in SD)
SHIFT 2 → 1 【EXE】 → x̄ ≈ 82.143. SHIFT 2 → 2 or 3 for σx / sx. Square it for variance

body.text: Question: Use this program to solve the case: Five equal scores of 10.
Question: Use this program to solve the case: FreqOff leftover.
Given: If you created the program in SD but FreqOff is still on, X ; Y DT is Syntax ERROR.

items: The first statement FreqOn in the listing forces frequency on each run
If you still see Syntax ERROR, enter SD with MODE 4, SHIFT MODE ◀ ◀ 1, then run again

body.label: Pitfalls
body.text: ClrStat is SHIFT 9 1 while editing. DT is the M+ key in SD. Maximum 40 FreqOn records. This program does not print σ itself — it only loads the list.
